About

Taha Sabry is a Moroccan comic artist who started his journey in 2018. He has worked on various projects, including the award-winning short story “Break the Cycle”, which won the African Talents Award at the 16th Tetouan Festival in 2023. His work also includes contributions to local Moroccan anthologies with Alkhariqun and a one-shot titled “The Adventures of Sinbad” on the Manga Arabia app. Currently developing personal projects like Mushroom and Space Pirates, Taha is always eager to learn and open to collaborating with writers and publishers.

How it works

  1. 1

    Brief. Send the script / references, page count and deadline.

  2. 2

    Quote. A final price and schedule, confirmed in writing. 50% deposit to start, paid via PayPal.

  3. 3

    Sketches / layouts. You approve the composition before final art.

  4. 4

    Revisions. Two rounds included. Additional rounds quoted separately.

  5. 5

    Delivery. Final files in print-ready quality; remaining 50% on approval.

Good to know: rush jobs +25–50% · volume discount on large projects (20+ pages) · commercial use or full rights quoted per project · payment can be split per batch of pages.
